name: Traveling Keynote Modern
tagline: Dark tropical travel keynote with aerial-photo atmosphere, translucent rounded white title cards, tiny logo marks, and calm health-story pacing.

palette.description: Dark palm and lagoon greens with white translucent cards, charcoal text, and a small coral action accent.

typography.style: Modern rounded sans with compact logo text and centered rounded keynote cards.

best_for: Travel keynotes, wellness journeys, destination narratives, and image-led lifestyle presentations.
avoid_for: Dense business reporting, finance tables, or legal/technical documentation.

source_inspiration.name: Visme Travelling Keynote Presentation Modern
source_inspiration.notes: Rebuilt as source-inspired portable HTML/CSS from public visual references; no source asset files are embedded.
